user:
cd app && for package in $(grep -v '^#' ../app-7.md5 | awk '{print $2}'); do
  packagedir=${package%.tar.?z*}
  tar -xf $package
  pushd $packagedir
    ./configure $XORG_CONFIG
    make
  popd
done
package:
cd app && for package in $(grep -v '^#' ../app-7.md5 | awk '{print $2}'); do
  packagedir=${package%.tar.?z*}
  pushd $packagedir
    make install DESTDIR=$DESTDIR
  popd
  rm -rf $packagedir
done
